note: Classic NPC system, step A (Radar, Steve-approved 2026-10-21; design in items/NPC_DESIGN.md). packages: what an NPC does in a slot; 'marker' is the kind of world marker it goes to (bed, chair, post) and 'state' the body state there. schedule: 24 hourly slots of package names, read with the NPC's own jitter (+/- jitter_min). Beyond active_radius_m from every player an NPC is dormant: not simulated, placed at the marker its schedule says when a player comes in range. Tick rates by distance to the nearest player: near (hz_near within near_m), mid (hz_mid within mid_m), far (hz_far). Markers live in markers.json (x, z; the ground gives y) and admin additions in the store folder. test_hold (Dave 2026-10-21, TEST): while an NPC id is listed there it does that package all day (Hob at a post, Edda in a chair, both facing the spawn x 53301 z 68427); delete test_hold to restore the day schedules. Routines (build 566): packages eat (table), wander (square, a short walk about the town) and shelter (a roofed marker). In rain at or above shelter_rain an NPC doing a package listed in shelter_from goes to the nearest free shelter marker instead and returns when it stops. Every schedule is 24 slots naming a package; tests/test_npc_routines.gd checks sleep hours, marker kinds and slot counts.
